entities.summary: Mark Letestu is a Canadian former professional ice hockey forward and current head coach of the American Hockey League’s Colorado Eagles. He played in eleven seasons of the National Hockey League (NHL) for the Pittsburgh Penguins, Columbus Blue Jackets, Edmonton Oilers and Winnipeg Jets.
